steps.title: more than one right flip
steps.body:
Try the same sample at 0, −2 and +3 semitones against the backing. More than one landing works: on the root, on the 5th, as the relative major or minor, as a 9th.

`check my flip` lists every consonant landing, ranked by how far the sample had to move (fewer semitones keeps more of its sound), and says which one you got.
